source: World of Darkness Campaign Assistant: Generator Prototype Specifications
governance: CHRONICLE SPATIAL ENGINE: MASTER SPECIFICATION & ARCHITECTURE GOVERNANCE

mundaneBase.name: Back Alley
mundaneBase.description: Narrow corridor between 4th and 5th Ave, choked with old grease traps and electronic waste bins.

prototypes.kindredLayer: Nosferatu Dead-Drop: External AC units from the computer shop hum to mask whispered conversations. Analog hardware box hides encrypted data files behind the mainframe racks.
prototypes.umbralLayer: Weaver Choke Point: Gauntlet Rating: 9. Pattern Spiders swarm the electronic waste, completely choking out organic emotional resonance. Exhausting for shapeshifters.
prototypes.awakenedVector: Technocracy Vector: Iteration X passive tracking hub. Spoofs local MAC addresses using localized router injection to monitor clandestine activities.

mundaneBase.name: 24-Hour Laundromat
mundaneBase.description: Fluorescent lights flicker over rusted metal washers; air smells of industrial detergent and stagnant water.

prototypes.kindredLayer: Anarch Feeding Ground: Low-risk hunting zone for transient neonates. The blind spot behind the commercial dryers acts as an unmapped meeting point.
prototypes.umbralLayer: Stagnant Pool: Localized spirits of apathy cling to the broken machines. The Gauntlet is porous but slick with spiritual residue.
prototypes.awakenedVector: Coincidental Sanctum: The rhythmic spinning of drum #7 aligns with local reality matrices, allowing safe sensory dampening paradox reduction.

mundaneBase.name: Subway Transit Station
mundaneBase.description: Subterranean concrete platforms covered in brake dust, echoing with high-pitched screeching rails.

prototypes.kindredLayer: Ventrue Domain Border: Strictly patrolled by mortal security thralls. Tremere glyphs are subtly scrawled in UV paint along the tunnel arches to track intruders.
prototypes.umbralLayer: Underground Warren: Deep tunnels intersect old tunnels claimed by feral Rat-Spirits. Highly volatile zone for corporate-aligned lupines.
prototypes.awakenedVector: Void Engineers Outpost: Sub-surface transit tracking grid monitors anomaly movements through subterranean infrastructure lines.

mundaneBase.name: Condemned Tenement
mundaneBase.description: Boarded-up windows, rotting floorboards, and structural cracks exposing skeletal rebar.

prototypes.kindredLayer: Hollow Haven: Temporary squat for unaligned Caitiff or low-humanity neonates seeking shelter from the rising sun.
prototypes.umbralLayer: Bane Infestation: Rot and decay spirits feed on the historical suffering within the walls. The Gauntlet is heavily corrupted.
prototypes.awakenedVector: Nephandi Residue: Faint traces of broken logic and inverted geometry linger in the dark corners of the top floor apartment.

mundaneBase.name: Rooftop Parking Deck
mundaneBase.description: Exposed concrete structure overlooking the neon skyline, smelling of gas fumes and rain-slicked asphalt.

prototypes.kindredLayer: Harpy Vantage Point: Neutral ground where local Toreador gather to trade secrets without the immediate oversight of the Prince's Court.
prototypes.umbralLayer: Glade Anchor: High wind-spirits pass over the roof. Garou can use the clear line of sight to commune with sky elementals if city smog is low.
prototypes.awakenedVector: Etherite Observatory: Temporary node used to measure celestial light pollution distortions against the consensus reality grid.

mundaneBase.name: 24-Hour Corner Deli
mundaneBase.description: A small bodega jammed with cheap groceries, neon beer signs, and bulletproof counter glass.

prototypes.kindredLayer: Circulatory System Node: The owner pays a blood tithe to local ghouls in exchange for protection from predatory street gangs.
prototypes.umbralLayer: Urban Feeding Ground: Minor spirits of gluttony and anxiety fight for crumbs near the greasy grill hoods.
prototypes.awakenedVector: Hedge Magic Focus: The cashier preserves ancient folk charms inside common lottery ticket arrangements to ward off misfortune.

mundaneBase.name: Botanical Greenhouse
mundaneBase.description: Glass-domed municipal structure holding tropical flora amid humid, heavy air and rich soil smells.

prototypes.kindredLayer: Gangrel Sanctuary: Quiet refuge within urban borders. Animalism users utilize the root structures and insect colonies for local intelligence networks.
prototypes.umbralLayer: Wyld Pocket: Unexpectedly low Gauntlet Rating: 4. A rare urban sanctuary where plant spirits retain their ancient form and memories.
prototypes.awakenedVector: Verbena Grove: Cultivated node where living patterns are manipulated through traditional blood sacral rites under the guise of botany.

mundaneBase.name: Automotive Salvage Yard
mundaneBase.description: Mountains of crushed cars, broken glass, and mud pits leaking dark engine oil into the earth.

prototypes.kindredLayer: Brujah Staging Ground: Scrap processing noise masks firearms training and political dissent assemblies away from Elysium eyes.
prototypes.umbralLayer: Weaver/Wyrm Warzone: Toxic waste elementals clash violently with industrial machinery spirits over ownership of the deep soil.
prototypes.awakenedVector: Hermetic Forge: Scrap metals are scanned for historical symbolic resonance to forge modern defensive artifacts.

mundaneBase.name: Steam Ventilation Vault
mundaneBase.description: Bricked-up utility access blasting scalding white vapor into the freezing night air.

prototypes.kindredLayer: Nosferatu Escape Hatch: Lever system behind the copper valve drops directly into sewer mains, bypassing street level pursuit teams.
prototypes.umbralLayer: Steam Elemental Nest: Angry, volatile spirits of pressure and heat congregate here, easily provoked by physical interference.
prototypes.awakenedVector: Athanor Matrix: Alchemical mages use the thermal differential to refine volatile base materials without triggering paradox alarms.

mundaneBase.name: Historic Churchyard
mundaneBase.description: Weathered slate tombstones shadowed by monolithic iron gates and ancient oak trees.

prototypes.kindredLayer: Giovanni / Hecata Vault: Ancestral crypt serves as a secure anchor point for necromantic rituals and soul transactions.
prototypes.umbralLayer: The Silent Verge: Gauntlet borders the Shadowlands closely. Screams from the Underworld can occasionally be heard by sensitive lupines.
prototypes.awakenedVector: Celestial Chorus Node: High faith resonance provides a passive ward against vulgar manifestations of dark sorcery.

pressureVariants.title: Quiet Observation
pressureVariants.effect: A hidden watcher records the group without acting.
pressureVariants.mechanicalSeed: Identify the observer before the next scene.

pressureVariants.title: Municipal Intervention
pressureVariants.effect: Permits, inspections, closures, or code enforcement threaten the arrangement.
pressureVariants.mechanicalSeed: A mundane deadline advances whenever attention rises.

pressureVariants.title: Faction Challenge
pressureVariants.effect: A rival faction makes a deniable territorial claim.
pressureVariants.mechanicalSeed: The first overt power use changes local influence.

pressureVariants.title: Human Witness
pressureVariants.effect: A civilian has noticed the pattern and is collecting evidence.
pressureVariants.mechanicalSeed: The witness can become an asset, liability, or dependent.

pressureVariants.title: Corporate Acquisition
pressureVariants.effect: A shell company is buying, demolishing, or securitizing the site.
pressureVariants.mechanicalSeed: Trace ownership to reveal the supernatural beneficiary.

pressureVariants.title: Spiritual Disturbance
pressureVariants.effect: The Gauntlet, Dreaming, Shadow, resonance, or occult geometry destabilizes.
pressureVariants.mechanicalSeed: Add one environmental manifestation per unresolved scene.

pressureVariants.title: Internal Betrayal
pressureVariants.effect: Someone inside the controlling group trades access for protection.
